t: You're in Prince's Gardens, a garden square in the City of Westminster. The name points back to Prince Albert of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha, who married Queen Victoria in February 1840 and was her consort until he died in 1861. Victoria gave him the title Prince Consort in 1857. Beyond that, the material I have for this square is thin, so I'll leave it there and let you enjoy the surroundings.
